reason: Classify intentional optimistic retries, stale-reference skips, typed routing catches, and unsupported-steering fallbacks so the repository-wide diagnostic blind-spot audit distinguishes reviewed control flow from lost failures. Five focused lifecycle cases cover restart recovery, agent-message delivery, goal charging, and harness steering.
exclusions: No frontend, native, Playwright, browser, mobile, LAN-origin, command runtime, provider transport, or unrelated backend tests are selected. This is a comment-only classification repair with no runtime behavior or API/UI shape change; the authoritative diagnostic audit is also run directly and in CI.
